a: useState returns [value, setValue] for local component state.
useEffect runs side effects after render; dependency array controls when.
Keys help React match list items across renders; use stable unique ids.
Props pass data from parent to child and should be treated as read-only.
Use && or ternary to render UI based on a condition.
<>...</> groups children without adding a DOM node.
Value comes from state and onChange updates state.
Move shared state up to the nearest common parent.
React.memo skips re-render when props are shallow-equal.
Use Link or NavLink for client-side navigation without full reload.
